description: Request conformance (REQ-01): rows of the scope matrix, response model and request-cost suites under core/test/server/conformance that fail against today's pipeline. Each entry names the REQ package whose change makes it pass; that package deletes it.

entries.reason: The not-found page renders from app.notFound, outside the route chain, so the extension request scopes (the tenant) never run around it.

test: answers HEAD like GET, without a body
entries.reason: HEAD is answered with an empty body and no Content-Length, while GET of the same route carries one.

test: builds at most one Response after the handler
entries.reason: The compression stage sets Vary with c.header() on the finished response (core/src/server/response-compression.ts); Hono rebuilds the response from it, and the Node adapter's lightweight Response materializes a native one for the body and another for the new response's init: one lightweight and two native Responses after the handler.

test: builds no ReadableStream for a bytes body
entries.reason: The ETag stage tees and re-wraps a bytes body that declares no length, building streams for a body that is already complete.
The request id and the facade scope each open their own AsyncLocalStorage run per request.

test: resolves no session for a request without a credential
entries.reason: Route chains resolve the session on entry whether or not the request carries a credential.
The HTML error page resolves the session for a request that carries no credential.
Compression creates an engine for every compressible response, including bodies under 1024 bytes.

test: makes exactly one store round trip
entries.reason: A page cache hit reads the generation token and the entry in two store round trips.
The page cache stores load() props, not the response, so a hit renders the page again.
The page cache stores load() props only; a hit still renders and compresses the document.

test: resolves the file with at most one open and no other path operation
entries.reason: Before serving, the public-files middleware lstats the file and probes its .br and .gz siblings with two more lstat calls, realpaths it, and the serve-static handler stats it again (statSync) before its read stream opens it once. REQ-10 serves small assets from inline bytes (no open) and larger ones with a single open.
The public-files middleware lstats the file, probes its .br and .gz siblings (two more lstat calls) and realpaths it before it can answer 304.
A request for a missing file probes the file system before falling through to the 404.
